name: music-metadata-browser
reason: An exploratory parseBuffer run yielded WAV fields, but its pinned release README describes a discontinued wrapper without documenting that local input API directly. API documentation for this release remains to be tied down.

name: @ts-audio/wav
reason: The package exports WavDemuxer, but its README documents a different audiox API; a documented WAV input call and control result remain unresolved.

name: @audio/wav-decode
reason: An exploratory decode returned PCM samples, but the pinned package has no README documenting its input API. It is also likely to share the wav-decoder family; release documentation needs checking.

name: @dantheman827/taglib-ts
reason: Project documentation claims WAV tag reading, but the local input API and control result have not been checked.

name: riff-reader
reason: RIFF-reader documentation and WAV-specific output against the control have not been checked.

name: is-wav
reason: Documents only a WAV signature check; it does not expose parsed fields or samples.

name: wav-encoder
reason: Documents WAV generation, with no WAV input parsing API.

name: audiobuffer-to-wav
reason: Converts an AudioBuffer into WAV bytes; no WAV input parsing API.

name: wav-headers
reason: Generates WAV header bytes and does not read WAV input.
